sourceConcept: population receptive fields in human visual cortex grow with eccentricity
detectionConcept: multi-branch receptive-field module (RFB) for one-stage detectors
mapping: RFB Net builds a convolutional block whose branch kernel sizes and dilation-controlled eccentricities mimic how cortical receptive fields change with eccentricity, so feature discriminability improves without a deeper, heavier backbone.

sourceConcept: saccadic eye movements that sample only informative image regions
mapping: CornerNet-Saccade treats inference like a saccade: an attention map predicts promising locations on a downsized image and high-resolution crops are processed only there, cutting the number of pixels examined rather than scanning the whole image.

sourceConcept: Bayesian neural network predictive uncertainty with loss attenuation
detectionConcept: per-box Gaussian localization uncertainty used to suppress false positives
mapping: Gaussian YOLOv3 imports Kendall and Gal's Bayesian uncertainty modeling: every box coordinate gets a Gaussian, an NLL loss attenuates noisy targets during training, and predicted uncertainty down-weights detections during post-processing.

sourceConcept: Kalman-filter state estimation for forecasting object motion
detectionConcept: learned trend-aware box forecasting for streaming detection
mapping: For streaming perception the corpus sets learned dual-flow trend forecasting against classical Kalman-filter forecasting as the baseline to beat, replacing explicit state estimation with learned motion cues that the paper reports are far cheaper per frame.

sourceConcept: optimal transport with supply and demand constraints solved by entropic Sinkhorn-Knopp iteration
detectionConcept: global positive/negative label assignment across anchors and ground truths
mapping: OTA formulates label assignment as an optimal transport problem in which each ground truth is a supplier of k labels and each anchor a demander of one, solved by Sinkhorn-Knopp instead of per-object hand-crafted thresholds; YOLOX then adopts the same OT assignment as its SimOTA base.

sourceConcept: forward noising process with a learned reverse denoising process
detectionConcept: object detection as a noise-to-box denoising process (DiffusionDet)
mapping: DiffusionDet recasts detection as a diffusion process: ground-truth boxes are padded and noised in training and the model learns to reverse that process, so inference starts from random Gaussian boxes and iteratively refines them into object boxes.

detectionConcept: detector recipe, anchor and augmentation tuning
mapping: YOLOv4 and YOLOv4-large outsource design choices to evolution: genetic algorithms select anchor boxes and the bag-of-freebies hyper-parameters alongside k-means clustering, replacing hand-tuning of each training and architecture choice.

sourceConcept: autoregressive language modeling over discrete token sequences
detectionConcept: boxes and classes emitted as generated token sequences (Pix2Seq)
mapping: Pix2Seq casts object detection as a language modeling task: boxes and labels are quantized into discrete tokens and decoded autoregressively with a generic maximum-likelihood objective, so no detection-specific architecture or loss is needed.

sourceConcept: phrase grounding, aligning regions to noun phrases in a text prompt
detectionConcept: open-vocabulary detection via unified region-language grounding
mapping: GLIP reformulates classification as grounding every region to phrases of a text prompt, and Grounding DINO and YOLOE extend the same language-grounding idea so arbitrary categories can be named by text or prompts at inference time.
